name: GD Medal AutoClip
description: Automatically triggers Medal's clip hotkey for Geometry Dash new bests and level completions.

clip-hotkey.name: Medal Clip Hotkey
clip-hotkey.description: The global Medal hotkey to press. Defaults to F8. Supports F1-F24, A-Z, 0-9, SPACE, TAB, ENTER, INSERT, DELETE, HOME, END, PAGEUP and PAGEDOWN.

capture-delay.name: Capture Delay (milliseconds)
capture-delay.description: Wait this long after detecting the event before pressing Medal's clip hotkey.
